items.label: All-Weather Durability & Effortless Care
items.value: Built to endure the elements, this patio furniture set combines UV-resistant resin wicker with rustproof steel framing, standing strong against sun, rain, and snow. Wicker Patio furniture fade-proof and crack-resistant retains its beauty season after season with minimal maintenance required

items.label: Adaptive Comfort for Every Moment
items.value: Sink into our outdoor furniture set high-resiliency foam cushions that cradle your body without sagging, while breathable pillows provide lumbar support. The patio sets with widened seats and padded armrests invite you to lounge, stretch out, or curl up during lively conversations or lazy stargazing. With modular sectional armless and armchair pieces, customize your layout in L-shape, U-shape, or linear configurations to suit any occasion from cozy family nights to lively gatherings

items.label: Warmth, Ambiance & Uncompromising Safety
items.value: Elevate your outdoor experience with the 50,000 BTU fire pit table, radiating cozy warmth year-round whether during a crisp autumn evening or a chilly winter night. CSA-certified and designed with explosion-proof glass stones, anti-leak valves, and adjustable heat control, it blends stunning visuals with peace of mind. The pure copper wiring and sturdy hose ensure reliable performance as the heart of your outdoor sanctuary

items.label: Enhanced Wide-Arm Comfort
items.value: Upgrade your relaxation with 8-inch wider armrests generously padded for unparalleled support. Whether resting a drink, propping up a book, or simply lounging, the extra space provides superior elbow-to-wrist comfort compared to standard designs. These broad, cushioned arms redefine outdoor ease

items.label: Stress-Free Outdoor Living
items.value: Leave the patio conversation sets outdoors worry-free with thick all-season cushions that resist temperature swings, and rustproof joints that withstand coastal humidity. Horn-button straps keep cushions securely anchored, while the neutral-toned wicker effortlessly complements any decor. Lightweight yet sturdy construction for poolsides, patios, or garden nooks, transforming your space into a resort-style retreat

items.label: Dedicated Support & Seamless Experience
items.value: Rest assured with 24/7 customer service and convenient logistics. Your patio set arrives in multiple boxes for easy handling, and our team is always ready to assist with assembly or queries. Outdoor luxury designed for lasting memories where comfort, style, and durability meet

items.label: Modular Configuration Options
items.value: Rearrange the sectional pieces to create multiple seating arrangements including L-shape, U-shape, or linear configurations to accommodate different group sizes and outdoor space layouts for various entertaining needs
